name: phd-4plus1-hyphenated-notre-dame
description: Red-team 2026-09-13: a 4+1 student whose transcript (or typing) spells the university "Notre-Dame" is the same student as one who spells it "University of Notre Dame". The old isNotreDameInstitution regex read \s* between the two words, so a hyphen silently zeroed the credit, refused the course as a §5.2 transfer it never was, and dropped it out of the DGS review request. isNotreDameInstitution now folds the name through normalizeUniversity first.
